title: Put 9 more merged calculator changes on the hosted site, and approve their new words?
bluf: Tap a, b or c. a deploys main e6f92a5 to the hosted calculator: 9 changes merged since this morning's deploy (PRs #74 to #82). Users will notice: the Deals won list titled 'Deals won'; 'Your feedback could not be sent. Try again.'; the headline 'Some values are below 0.' with each line and column named; two new item classes, Care pack and Staging; and, on a deal-usage quote only, the deal's mono and colour rates printed on the customer proposal. No screen makes a deal-usage quote yet; only the API can. Before you tap: once anyone adds a Care pack or Staging item, the only way is forward, because today's version would refuse to start or would hide those quotes. The proposal rates print 'Monochrome office prints' and 'Colour office prints' against Large format, Software, Services and Other too. The one-pager shows at most 6 rates, so deals with 4 or more classes hide rows. A deal quote approved before the deploy gains the rate rows on its proposal. Your large-format items still wait, because MPSCALC-202 is not merged. The Entra group step is still yours. Main's CI on e6f92a5 is green, so the package exists. The words list is in your drawer as the W2 file ('MPS words list W2'): 3 items you already approved, 5 NEW, and two yes/no questions (OBS-1, OBS-2) that do not block this card.

options.label: Deploy main e6f92a5 and approve the NEW words in list W2
options.detail: One MPS seat deploys from the CI package, from a checkout at e6f92a5, and keeps today's 12f8e566 build (cdfe793e..., 50 files) as the way back. It checks the site and a quote, and Tuesday reports the result.

options.label: Deploy cfe376d5 instead: everything except the proposal deal rates (#82)
options.detail: cfe376d5 is main just before #82. It is a gated tree (0f42ab5c), its CI run succeeded, and its package is available until 24 October. The deal rates, and with them B170-3/-4/-5 and OBS-1/-2, wait for a later card. List W2 items 1-5, 7 and 8 are approved; item 6 is not needed.

options.label: Not now
options.detail: Nothing is deployed. The hosted site stays on this morning's 12f8e566.

default_action: If you don't answer, c: nothing is deployed; Tuesday re-raises Monday 19 October.
